overloadPatches.semanticRole: Fills the strings array with every string from a STR# resource (or, for XLIFF-based compatibility, an open XLIFF file's 'group' element) identified by resID.

params.name: resID
params.description: Resource ID number or 'id' attribute of the 'group' element (XLIFF)

params.name: strings
params.description: Strings from the STR# resource or Strings from the 'group' element (XLIFF)

params.name: resFile
params.description: Resource file reference number. If omitted: all the XLIFF files or open resources files are searched.

constraints: If the resource is not found, the strings array is left unchanged and the OK system variable is set to 0.

resFile's 'Time' type is not a clock time -- it's 4D's legacy opaque handle type for resource-file reference numbers, the same type OPEN RESOURCE FILE returns its result as (see https://developer.4d.com/docs/commands/open-resource-file). Confirmed as the correct, intentional type, not a documentation error.
